system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

An ally falls and you refuse to let them stay there. You keep their flame alive with but a glance and bellowing command to survive.

As an Action, all allied creatures you can see within 20 feet of you, who are Incapacitated, Stunned, Dying or Unconscious makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. You can spend any number of Will as part of this action. For every Will spent, all affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to this saving throw. On a successful save:

If they had 0 hit points, they immediately spend all remaining hit die, regaining the result and gain ranks of Exhaustion equal to half the spent hit die.

If they had hit points, they lose all of the listed conditions, and stand from prone.

Creatures cannot be affected by this feature more than once per long rest.
